task.title: To select Objects
task.shortdesc: Rakesh Singh Example In the ribbon menu, click Objects .

step.cmd: In the ribbon menu, click Objects.
In the Objects list, locate Opportunity, either by scrolling or by typing in the first letter to jump to the nearest match and then scrolling.
Click Add Parent Object. This will always be true if you have just one object. The object is now in the selected box on the right and is automatically assigned default List behavior.
In Add Fields below, select the following field names: Account ID, Amount, Close Date, Name, Owner ID, and Stage.
Click Apply. Note: You must click Apply after you have selected the fields for any object or these will not be saved if you have more than one object.
